failureObservedDuringDevelopment.first: The process verification test exceeded its former 30-second total test deadline during concurrent work.
failureObservedDuringDevelopment.second: After adding a shutdown bound, one full run passed 179/180 tests; Windows verification did not confirm process termination within 7 seconds. The original PID was absent when subsequently inspected. The precise timing cause was not established.
failureObservedDuringDevelopment.change: Verification now bounds shutdown at 20 seconds and retains taskkill diagnostics; an unconfirmed shutdown rejects verification and cannot enable apply. The real multi-process test has a 120-second total budget. The final full run above passed without bypassing termination checks.

limitations: Some completed-review records are controlled persistence fixtures, not model output.
No live agent is automatically resumed; a disconnected record does not prove that its old process exited.
Installed VSIX restart and complete recovery UI sequence remain to be verified.
External projects, independent dependency installation, Linux live inference, power loss and leftover temporary-file cleanup remain outside this evidence.
